themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, Italy, and Sweden are simultaneously advancing policies that prioritize native citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme reflects a shared transnational strategy to appeal to anti-immigration sentiment and consolidate voter bases by institutionalizing exclusionary practices.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump’s foreign policy decisions, particularly regarding Iran and China, as well as domestic economic and judicial moves, are shaping right-wing narratives worldwide. This theme highlights how Trump’s actions serve as a reference point for right-wing parties in Europe and Latin America, either as a model to emulate or a cautionary tale.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Sweden, and France are gaining significant traction in polls, reflecting a broader European trend of increasing support for nationalist and anti-establishment movements. This theme captures the parallel electoral successes and the shared strategies of these parties to capitalize on voter dissatisfaction.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Poland, Hungary, and Argentina are experiencing significant internal strife, with factions clashing over leadership, policy direction, and alliances. This theme underscores the fragility of these movements despite their electoral successes and the challenges they face in maintaining unity.

themes.title: Energy crisis fuels EU fiscal rule debates
themes.blurb: The energy crisis, exacerbated by geopolitical tensions, is prompting right-wing governments in Italy, Germany, and Spain to push for greater fiscal flexibility within the EU. This theme highlights the shared economic challenges and the political strategies employed to address them, often at odds with EU fiscal constraints.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni urges EU to relax fiscal rules for energy spending, citing economic risks from the Iran conflict.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
